limits: Visibility score predicts only pregrasp camera coverage; it is not a probability or safety certificate.
Automatic recovery is restricted to whitelisted failures before empty descent/contact/closure, with checked retreat and fresh stationary-source confirmation.
No tabletop rearrangement, no physical reset between attempts or rounds, no object truth in control.

Three controlled runs: recovery passed; two all-live runs stopped (native crash and post-grasp destination evidence expired). No random success-rate claim. Original 8130/8131 were not physically rerun in this revision.
